title: Braze (344)
problem: Text: "Class Strength" Artifact properties deal 50% more damage. Code: when the attacker has an artifact and the target is of one of the 5 classes, it adds +50% of the whole hit. It doesn't scale the property and doesn't check that the artifact has that class's property at all. Every target has a class, so in practice it is a flat +50% for any of your creatures with an artifact. The Beacon card set part was not checked.
notes: Community claim: Counts as Class Strength but is worked out separately, so card set bonuses raise it. Evidence: bc_EventDamage L4036 (source has item), L4038 (scr_CreatureClass(creature)), L4039 property term, L4040-L4041 Braze pool += amount × 0.5; gates @0x140e6fc11 / 0x140e70710 / 0x140e7120f / 0x140e71d0e / 0x140e7280d. Fix sketch: Make Braze use 50% of the property term (stat / 100 × amount) instead of the amount (H) Triage 2026-10-26: In-game test: a creature whose Artifact has no Class Strength property, with and without Braze: does Braze still add +50% damage? (Same pattern as Unbreakable SU-0058.) | 2026-10-26 realign (text is the contract): text claims "Class Strength Artifact properties deal 50% more damage to that class". H: Braze: +50% of the attacker's Class Strength property for the target's class instead of a flat +50% of the hit. vs bugged: weaker (no flat 50%). | In-game test: Braze with an Artifact without a Class Strength property: no extra damage; with a +X% vs a class property: that bonus grows by 50% against that class only.

release_notes.intended: Your creatures' Class Strength Artifact properties deal 50% more damage to that class.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, any creature with an Artifact got a flat +50% damage, with or without a Class Strength property.
release_notes.fix: Now the bonus raises the Class Strength property's own damage bonus by 50%, against that class only.
